name: Refrigerator Production Line Solution
summary: A full-line automation solution for refrigerator manufacturers, covering assembly, inspection, and packaging processes.
contentHtml:
The Refrigerator Production Line Solution is a full-line automation solution provided by TXAM for home appliance manufacturers.

Solution Components

The full line covers compressor installation, panel assembly, pipeline connection, electrical wiring, and final inspection and packaging processes.

Solution Advantages

  • High level of full-line automation
  • Flexible production for multiple models
  • Automated inspection ensures quality
  • Efficient packaging system
  • Turnkey project service

Service Content

Provides full-process support including line planning, equipment manufacturing, installation and debugging, and after-sales service.
